strings.reviews.cycle_alpha_description: Early reader pass for premise, clarity, major confusion, pacing, and whether the story is working.
strings.reviews.cycle_authenticity_description: Focused pass for identity, lived experience, cultural context, representation, and authenticity.
strings.reviews.cycle_technical_description: Specialist pass for factual accuracy, terminology, procedures, continuity, and domain-specific details.
strings.reviews.cycle_proof_description: Final pass for typos, punctuation, spelling, formatting, and small correctness issues.
strings.reviews.cycle_copy_description: Mechanical pass for grammar, usage, consistency, spelling, punctuation, and style-guide adherence.
strings.reviews.preset_reader_description: Early and later outside-reader feedback without a full editorial sequence.
strings.reviews.preset_editorial_description: Big-picture revision through sentence-level editing, copy editing, and final proof.
strings.reviews.preset_full_description: A complete fiction-oriented path from early readers through revision, beta feedback, editing, and proof.
strings.reviews.preset_specialist_description: Focused expert passes for authenticity and factual or domain-specific accuracy.

strings.reviews.questionnaire_feedback_help: Responses submitted for this frozen round.
strings.reviews.questionnaire_alpha_q1: Where did the story first pull you in, and where did your attention start to drift?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_alpha_q2: What do you think the story is promising you at this point?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_alpha_q3: Which character do you understand best, and which do you understand least? Why?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_alpha_q4: Where were you confused about what was happening or why it mattered?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_alpha_q5: What are you most curious or eager to learn next?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_alpha_q6: If you stopped reading here, what would most likely be the reason?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_developmental_q1: What does the protagonist want, and is that goal clear early enough?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_developmental_q2: Where do the stakes or central conflict feel strongest, and where do they feel weakest?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_developmental_q3: Which scenes or chapters feel essential, repetitive, misplaced, or missing?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_developmental_q4: Where does the pacing drag, rush, or skip over something important?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_developmental_q5: Which character decisions, relationships, or changes feel unearned or inconsistent?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_developmental_q6: What single structural change would most improve the story?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_beta_q1: At what points were you most engaged, and where did you lose momentum?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_beta_q2: Which moments produced the strongest emotional reaction, and which fell flat?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_beta_q3: What did you predict would happen, and which reveals or twists surprised you?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_beta_q4: Were any motivations, relationships, world rules, or plot events confusing?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_beta_q5: Which characters or relationships did you care about most and least? Why?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_beta_q6: Did the ending feel earned and satisfying? What questions or expectations remain?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_line_q1: Which passages felt awkward, unclear, overwritten, or hard to read smoothly?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_line_q2: Where does the narrative voice feel strongest, and where does it become inconsistent?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_line_q3: Which dialogue sounds unnatural, repetitive, too explicit, or unlike the speaker?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_line_q4: Where is description too heavy, too thin, generic, or especially effective?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_line_q5: Where do sentence rhythm, repeated words, or paragraph structure make the prose drag?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_line_q6: Did you notice any distracting shifts in point of view, tense, distance, or tone?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_copy_q1: What recurring grammar, punctuation, or usage problems did you notice?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_copy_q2: Are spelling, capitalization, hyphenation, and compound words handled consistently?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_copy_q3: Are names, terminology, titles, and invented terms consistent throughout?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_copy_q4: Are numbers, dates, times, measurements, and other formatted elements consistent?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_copy_q5: Did you find factual, timeline, continuity, or internal-consistency problems?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_copy_q6: Are there style-guide choices that should be standardized before proofreading?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_proof_q1: Did you find any typos, missing words, duplicated words, or accidental substitutions?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_proof_q2: Did you notice incorrect punctuation, spacing, quotation marks, or capitalization?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_proof_q3: Are chapter titles, scene breaks, headings, and other structural elements formatted consistently?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_proof_q4: Did you find repeated lines, missing text, broken paragraphs, or layout artifacts?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_proof_q5: Are character names, place names, and recurring terms spelled consistently?
strings.reviews.questionnaire_proof_q6: Is there anything on the page that would make you stop publication to fix it first?

strings.account_security.title: Account & security
strings.account_security.intro: Manage how you sign in, two-step verification, and your active Breadmaker sessions. Sensitive changes require you to sign in again.
strings.account_security.signin_methods_help: These identities can open the same Breadmaker account. Email address alone never links accounts.
strings.account_security.two_step_help: Authenticator-app codes are owned and verified by Auth0; Breadmaker never stores the secret.
strings.account_security.totp_off_help: Optional for social sign-in. Enable it to require an authenticator code on future sign-ins.
strings.account_security.totp_required_help: Required because this account has an email/password sign-in method.
strings.account_security.totp_optional_help: Enabled for this account and required on future social sign-ins.
strings.account_security.sessions_help: Breadmaker uses opaque server-side sessions. Revoke a session you no longer recognize.
strings.account_security.recovery_help: Password resets and recovery codes stay with Auth0 so Breadmaker never handles recovery secrets.
strings.account_security.recovery_auth0_help: Use the Breadmaker sign-in screen to reset your password. Resetting a password does not disable two-step verification.
strings.account_security.action_failed: The security change could not be completed.
strings.account_security.enable_totp_confirm: You will sign in again, then Auth0 will show the authenticator-app enrollment screen. Breadmaker never receives the TOTP secret.
strings.account_security.unlink_confirm: You will sign in again before this method is removed. Your primary or last remaining sign-in method cannot be unlinked.
strings.account_security.disable_totp_confirm: You will sign in again before this authenticator method is removed. Email/password accounts cannot disable TOTP.
strings.account_security.revoke_session_confirm: You will sign in again before Breadmaker invalidates this session.
strings.account_security.sign_out_everywhere_con: You will sign in again, then Breadmaker will revoke Auth0 sessions and every Breadmaker session for this account.
